description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Karuppiah Pathmanathan as a Member of the Pasbage Korale P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pasbage Korale Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a seat that became vacant. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for government bodies.
